# Hudson Institute

> > Hudson Institute is a Washington, D.C.-based think tank focused on national security, human rights, and global policy challenges.

The institute conducts research and hosts events on critical issues including counterterrorism, international relations, religious freedom, and U.S. foreign policy. Hudson Institute features experts such as Olivia Enos, Nina Shea, and Michael Sobolik addressing threats from China, nuclear proliferation, and human rights abuses globally.

## Key Topics

- National Security
- Human Rights
- China Policy
- Counterterrorism
- Nuclear Non-Proliferation
- Religious Freedom
- Export Controls
- U.S. Foreign Policy
- Trade Policy
- East Asia Security
- Islamism
- Senate Policy
- Regulatory Reform
- European Identity
- Washington, D.C.

## National Security and Counterterrorism

- [Combating Nuclear Terrorism: Overcoming the Senate Impasse](http://www.hudson.org/events/981-combating-nuclear-terrorism-overcoming-the-senate-impasse112012): Past event on nuclear terrorism and Senate impasse (Nov 2012)
- [Nuclear Non-Proliferation and East Asia](http://www.hudson.org/events/745-nuclear-non-proliferation-and-east-asia22010): Past event on nuclear non-proliferation in East Asia (Feb 2010)
- [Eastern Sudan: Threats to the Beja People and Global Security](http://www.hudson.org/events/841-eastern-sudan-threats-to-the-beja-people-and-global-security42011): Past event on Beja People and Sudan security threats (Apr 2011)
- [The Patriot Act and the Internet: Recent Developments](http://www.hudson.org/events/925-the-patriot-act-and-the-internet-recent-developments32012): Past event on Patriot Act and internet policy (Mar 2012)
